header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S1 (§5a, D-38 / D-63). The Observer carries binoculars (kit 1) and a laser rangefinder (kit 2). A scripted trainee possesses him, binds his view to the BINOCULARS and presses ZOOM IN, then re-binds the view to the RANGEFINDER and presses MODE, then back to the plain eye. Judge: (1) the view shows the binoculars' HUD while bound to them and the rangefinder's after the re-bind - never the other's; (2) ZOOM IN steps the binoculars only, MODE steps the rangefinder only: a press reaches only the device the view shows; (3) while the view shows the binoculars he RAISES them (the held item - WeaponPosture.HeldItem Binoculars); the optic stays raised while the view shows his rangefinder (D-63: every hand-held device he views is raised the same way) and goes down when the view returns to the eye. Fail: a HUD in the wrong view, a press on the wrong device, or the binoculars not raised. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-switch-devices
